description: Returns stock trades disclosed by one member of Congress, newest trade first, with optional ticker and date-window filters. member_name must exactly match the member name as stored: the STOCK Act filer name with honorifics removed, which is often a legal name rather than the name the member is commonly known by. A name that does not match returns count 0 and no error, so resolve a common or partial name with search_members_and_tickers first. Only trades filed under that exact spelling are returned; for a member who filed under more than one spelling, use get_trade_feed with a partial name to include the other spellings.

days.description: Only trades whose trade date is within the last N days. Disclosures can arrive up to 45 days after the trade (later if filed late), so the newest part of the window is incomplete.

member_name.description: Exact stored member name, e.g. "Nancy Pelosi"; look it up with search_members_and_tickers

ticker.description: Filter to a specific ticker symbol, e.g. "NVDA"

name: get_member_trades
title: Member Trades
